names.legendary: Skimwell, Crown of the Eleven Ripples

lore.common: Has twenty-one sharp little ridges and keeps testing them on unsuspecting thumbs.
lore.uncommon: Lives in a pocket with loose coins and makes every washing machine sound like a treasure chest.
lore.rare: Skips across tables faster than any coin. The dominoes fear the sound of its landing.
lore.epic: Bounced off the kettle, the fridge and the mayor's spectacles in a single shot. Physicists insist the kitchen is too small.
lore.legendary: Skimwell once crossed an entire lake without sinking, then asked the fish to name the eleventh ripple. The lake has held competitions ever since.

names.legendary: Carafina, Keeper of the Unending Toast

lore.common: Sweats tiny drops onto the nicest tablecloth, then looks offended when someone fetches a coaster.
lore.uncommon: Glugs so loudly during dinner that an entire restaurant falls silent to listen.
lore.rare: Turns any drink fizzy whenever the waiter lies about the price. The wine list is now under investigation.
lore.epic: Poured one glass so generously it became a river through the dining room. Patrons continued their meals on floating bread baskets.
lore.legendary: At every celebration since the first harvest, Carafina has poured the final toast. Her waters never run dry, although she insists on a service charge.

names.legendary: Decantara, Vessel of the Last Sunset

lore.common: Wears a crystal hat and considers ordinary jugs beneath its station.
lore.uncommon: Sits on the shelf for twenty years without anyone daring to pour from it.
lore.rare: Casts rainbow light on the walls, revealing which dinner guests are secretly bored.
lore.epic: Poured one shimmering stream across the banquet hall and turned every chandelier into a dancing rainbow. The guests forgot the meal.
lore.legendary: Captured the last light of a dying sunset in its cut-glass heart. The stars still gather around it to see how the evening used to look.

names.legendary: Aquaflask, Keeper of the Last Sip

lore.common: Always rolls off the desk just as somebody starts a meeting.
lore.uncommon: Its cap goes missing the instant anyone gets thirsty. The cap denies involvement.
lore.rare: Can hold enough water to cross a desert, but leaks precisely one drop onto a homework page.
lore.epic: Unleashed its entire contents inside a school backpack, creating a miniature river through the corridors. The geography teacher claimed it for a lesson.
lore.legendary: When the longest drought silenced the wells, Aquaflask carried the final spring inside its steel heart. No traveler who shared a drink beside it was ever left thirsty.

names.legendary: Flasquinn, Keeper of the Final Sip

lore.common: Rattles against keys in a coat pocket and makes every quiet walk sound suspiciously musical.
lore.uncommon: Follows the curve of a jacket perfectly but somehow always digs into the wearer's ribs.
lore.rare: Keeps cocoa warm all the way to the summit, even when the snow has frozen the sandwiches solid.
lore.epic: Kept a whole mountain rescue team supplied with warm drinks through a blizzard. The kettle has demanded a medal too.
lore.legendary: Flasquinn carries the final sip from the first winter expedition. Any lost traveller who shares it with a stranger finds that the path home has grown shorter.

names.legendary: Scobert, the Wise Old Culture

lore.common: Hisses when opened like a tiny dragon with extremely healthy habits.
lore.uncommon: Smells like apple cider had a long argument with vinegar.
lore.rare: Keeps an increasingly intelligent jelly-like culture beneath its cap. The culture has begun grading the shopping list.
lore.epic: Erupted in the fridge and gave the vegetables an unexpected fizzy bath. The cucumber has been bubbling ever since.
lore.legendary: Scobert brewed for a century inside a sealed bottle and developed a civilisation of tiny cultures. Its citizens now petition for wider shelves and a national holiday called Fizzday.

names.legendary: Lady Milkworth, Keeper of the Dawn Round

lore.common: Waits on the doorstep at sunrise while the birds examine its shiny lid.
lore.uncommon: Clinks against the other glass bottles in the milk crate, waking the whole house.
lore.rare: Hides a thick crown of cream beneath its foil and defends it from curious blue tits.
lore.epic: Led a procession of clinking bottles down the frozen street when the milk float broke down. Every house still received its breakfast.
lore.legendary: Lady Milkworth delivered fresh milk through the snowiest winter on record. At dawn, a warm light shone from every doorstep she had passed.

names.legendary: Lady Sipple, Guardian of First Feasts

lore.common: Sits atop the baby bottle wearing its measuring ring like a very serious little hat.
lore.uncommon: Hides in the dishwasher's cutlery basket and pretends to be a tiny kitchen gadget.
lore.rare: Keeps milk flowing gently through a busy midnight feed while the sleepy parent struggles to stay awake.
lore.epic: Turned one baby's enormous satisfied burp into a lullaby that put the entire house to sleep. Even the kettle stopped humming.
lore.legendary: Lady Sipple watched over the first nursery of a legendary kingdom, ensuring every hungry little prince and princess was fed. Her soft crown was passed down through centuries of bedtime tales.

names.legendary: Doctor Twistcap of the Secret Shelf

lore.common: Rattles loudly on the highest shelf, as though reminding everyone to leave it alone.
lore.uncommon: Demands a push, a twist and a whispered password. Its plastic lid is very impressed with itself.
lore.rare: Enlarges its instructions whenever somebody genuinely needs to read them. The optician is losing business.
lore.epic: Resisted every attempt to open it during a power cut. Eventually the lid turned itself and politely explained the instructions.
lore.legendary: Doctor Twistcap guards the exact dose of medicine a sick village once desperately needed. Its lid opened for the healer alone, and its empty bottle still shines like a tiny lighthouse.

names.legendary: Sipparia, the Cup That Always Came Home

lore.common: Hits the kitchen floor with a triumphant clatter the moment the meal begins.
lore.uncommon: Leaks exactly one drop onto a fresh shirt no matter how carefully its lid is tightened.
lore.rare: Bounces back onto the highchair every time a toddler throws it. The toddler considers this a personal challenge.
lore.epic: Launched itself from every highchair in the nursery at once, starting a juice-fuelled dodgeball tournament. The staff requested helmets.
lore.legendary: Sipparia crossed oceans, forests and a very startled customs desk after being thrown from a highchair. She landed back beside the same toddler, who immediately threw her again.

names.legendary: Capsandra, Mistress of the Tiny Flood

lore.common: Pops open when it hears a rucksack zip and soaks all the homework inside.
lore.uncommon: Has more tooth marks than a dog toy and still insists it is brand new.
lore.rare: Can aim a single jet of water through six moving defenders and into the coach's whistle.
lore.epic: Hijacked the water bottles at a championship and turned the entire sideline into a synchronised fountain show.
lore.legendary: Capsandra holds back a waterfall with a single little plastic snap. When it opens, even the river asks permission to join the flood.

names.legendary: Recyclon, the Nine-Lived Vessel

lore.common: Crunches noisily whenever someone picks it up. Claims it is practising applause.
lore.uncommon: Rattles its pull tab like a tiny knight shaking a sword. The bin is unimpressed.
lore.rare: Uncrushes itself in the recycling bin each night. The collection truck now has twice the normal workload.
lore.epic: Rolled down the high street as a metallic cyclone, collecting every loose can into one enormous silver drum.
lore.legendary: Has been melted and reborn nine times as bicycle, saucepan, ladder and finally a can again. It remembers every shape and still insists the bike was best.

names.legendary: Colatron, Emperor of the Eternal Fizz

lore.common: Explodes into foam after being carried five metres. Says the journey was exhausting.
lore.uncommon: Makes somebody burp at the exact quiet moment of a wedding speech. Legendary timing.
lore.rare: Turns ice cubes into jumping popcorn, sending them skating across the table.
lore.epic: Sprayed a towering geyser of cola over the city parade. The marching band emerged sticky, caffeinated and playing twice as fast.
lore.legendary: Colatron holds the original bubble of the first fizzy drink, sealed beneath an ancient crown. Every time it laughs, a thousand unopened bottles hiss in fear.

names.legendary: Sir Popalot, Prince of the Last Fizz

lore.common: Hisses when opened and immediately regrets its confidence.
lore.uncommon: Rolls underneath the car seat and rattles through every important phone call.
lore.rare: Shakes itself without moving. The brave soul who pulls the tab becomes a fountain.
lore.epic: Led a rebellion of vending-machine cans against the office fridge. By morning every employee was sticky and the water cooler had surrendered.
lore.legendary: Sir Popalot once challenged a thunderstorm to a burping contest and won on the first sip. The storm now refuses to enter a vending machine without supervision.

names.legendary: Fizzabeth, Empress of the Last Pop

lore.common: Hisses whenever somebody says the word thirsty.
lore.uncommon: Tickles the roof of your mouth with a thousand tiny bubble fingers.
lore.rare: Shakes itself in the fridge, then erupts precisely when the white shirt arrives.
lore.epic: Uncorked an ocean of fizzy drink beneath the city, turning every manhole into a geyser and every pigeon into a reluctant swimmer.
lore.legendary: Fizzabeth kept a single bubble alive from the first drink ever carbonated. When it finally burst, the sound was heard in every pub that had ever existed.

names.legendary: Admiral Thermidor, the Unserved

lore.common: Lies on a white plate with claws crossed and a look of profound disappointment.
lore.uncommon: Demands three napkins and a tiny hammer before it will allow anyone near the butter.
lore.rare: Reassembles its cracked shell whenever the diners look away. The waiter has served it four times.
lore.epic: Escaped the royal banquet and led the silver cutlery into a mutiny. The guests finished their soup with forks.
lore.legendary: Admiral Thermidor was served at the feast of seven kings but refused to be eaten. Every year the empty platter returns to the table bearing a fresh crown of coral.

names.legendary: Daiquirion, Sovereign of the Sunset Sip

lore.common: Wears a tiny paper umbrella and considers itself dressed for a beach holiday.
lore.uncommon: Steals the cherry from another glass when nobody watches. Calls it mixology.
lore.rare: Changes flavour with the music. Jazz tastes like pineapple; techno tastes vaguely threatening.
lore.epic: Filled the royal swimming pool with glowing tropical punch and turned the palace ball into an unscheduled beach party.
lore.legendary: Daiquirion mixes sunsets in a glass and offers them to weary wanderers. Every sip tastes like the holiday they never took, though the tiny umbrella is always extra.

names.legendary: Selene's Cup, the Moonlit Mirror

lore.common: Collects dust overnight just before its owner takes a sip.
lore.uncommon: Slides toward the table edge whenever a sleepy hand reaches for the alarm.
lore.rare: Repositions itself exactly where someone's elbow will send it flying.
lore.epic: Leapt off the dining table and rained over the room without shattering. The dinner guests applauded; the cat requested an umbrella.
lore.legendary: Held a reflection of the moon so perfectly that the tide crept indoors to reclaim it. At dawn the waves retreated and left a pearl in its bottom.

names.legendary: Vinoria, the Purple Cartographer

lore.common: Sneaks a purple moustache onto every white napkin at dinner.
lore.uncommon: Swirls inside its glass like a tiny duchess judging the wallpaper.
lore.rare: Can turn a single spilled drop into a perfect portrait of the person who knocked the glass.
lore.epic: Baron Blotfang sent a crimson river across the royal banquet. The palace carpet now has its own nautical chart.
lore.legendary: Vinoria's oldest stain shows an island absent from every atlas. Once a century, ships follow its purple coastline and return carrying flowers that bloom only at midnight.

names.legendary: Sir Frankensnack, Lord of the Long Bun

lore.common: Escapes its bun one sausage-length at a time. Nobody has caught it before lunch.
lore.uncommon: Draws a mustard moustache on whoever takes the first bite.
lore.rare: Slides out of its bread and sprints around the picnic blanket, pursued by a pack of hungry terriers.
lore.epic: Grew across the entire stadium during half-time. The football match was postponed while the fans debated who got the mustard end.
lore.legendary: Sir Frankensnack once fed an army from a single enchanted hot dog that regrew every bite. The army won the war but lost the argument over onions.

names.legendary: Jarzilla, Devourer of the Dinner Table

lore.common: Holds a mysterious orange substance that tastes of carrots and betrayal. The baby has questions.
lore.uncommon: Slides off the spoon at exactly the wrong moment. Has decorated more walls than a professional painter.
lore.rare: Changes its contents from pea puree to strawberry mousse whenever a fussy baby complains. The parents are trying to negotiate a menu.
lore.epic: One mighty baby sneeze summoned a cyclone of mashed sweet potato that coated the entire kitchen. Archaeologists may one day identify it as the Orange Age.
lore.legendary: Jarzilla can turn any royal feast into a single spoonful of perfect puree. Emperors have begged for its power; toddlers routinely reject it with a raspberry.

names.legendary: Caviara, Duchess of the Thousand Pearls

lore.common: Arrives in a tiny tin at the price of a week's groceries. Expects its own spoon.
lore.uncommon: Pops in your mouth with the confidence of someone who owns the yacht.
lore.rare: Makes every cracker it touches demand silver cutlery. The cheese has started wearing a monocle.
lore.epic: Escaped a luxury banquet and scattered a thousand precious pearls beneath the guests' shoes. Nobody admitted how much they had paid to crawl on the carpet.
lore.legendary: Caviara rules a glittering court of tiny black pearls that mistake themselves for royalty. One bite grants perfect table manners and a crippling desire to own a yacht.

names.legendary: Ceramog, Warden of the Final Biscuit

lore.common: Clangs its lid every time a hand reaches in after bedtime.
lore.uncommon: Has a painted smile that grows wider as the biscuit count falls.
lore.rare: Teleports to the top shelf whenever children approach, then taunts them in the sound of clinking porcelain.
lore.epic: Announced every secret midnight snack over the neighbourhood loudspeakers. Three marriages survived; the school principal resigned.
lore.legendary: Guards a single biscuit said to grant eternal satisfaction. Thousands have attempted the heist; all returned claiming they only wanted tea.

names.legendary: Dippocrates, God of the Final Crisp

lore.common: Clings to the last crisp so nobody has to fight over it. Secretly loves the fighting.
lore.uncommon: Knows exactly who double-dipped. Announces their names at parties.
lore.rare: Lures every snack on the platter into its bowl. The celery has called for backup.
lore.epic: Rose from a mountain of nachos and swallowed an entire buffet. The only survivor was a suspiciously clean carrot stick.
lore.legendary: Once declared that no chip should ever be eaten dry. Its sacred bowl has been overflowing for centuries, and the priests still cannot find the lid.

names.legendary: Meloria, Keeper of the Golden Summer

lore.common: Refuses to fall off the spoon until someone has put on clean clothes.
lore.uncommon: Glues a breakfast spoon to the table with all the strength of a tiny golden dragon.
lore.rare: Turns ordinary toast into a golden spiral that tastes different with every bite.
lore.epic: Flowed from the royal beehives in a glittering river. The palace servants had to build tiny bridges for the jam jars.
lore.legendary: Meloria's honey never loses the warmth of the flowers it came from. A sealed pot discovered after a thousand winters still tasted of the summer when its bees were alive.

names.legendary: Jaromel, the Bottomless Honey Treasury

lore.common: Clings to its own lid so tightly that breakfast becomes a wrestling match.
lore.uncommon: Swallows the wooden dipper and makes everyone reach elbow-deep to retrieve it.
lore.rare: Attracts bees from every garden on the street whenever its lid clicks open. The bees arrive with tiny shopping lists.
lore.epic: Opened at the picnic and summoned every bear in the forest to a formal queue. The park ranger had to issue numbered tickets.
lore.legendary: Jaromel keeps the last spoonful of honey from the vanished royal apiary. Every spring its glass glows amber and the bees return to a garden no map remembers.

names.legendary: Hummusultan, Keeper of the Golden Dip

lore.common: Sits in a creamy swirl and watches everyone fight for the last piece of pita.
lore.uncommon: Breaks carrot sticks with suspicious precision, then blames the celery.
lore.rare: Transforms any ordinary vegetable into a crunchy delicacy. The broccoli now arrives wearing a dinner jacket.
lore.epic: Opened a whirlpool of olive oil in the middle of a buffet. A cucumber vanished, followed by the chef's favourite spoon.
lore.legendary: Hummusultan ruled the ancient chickpea gardens with a silver tahini sceptre. Its dip was so beloved that rival kings signed peace treaties over the last pita triangle.

names.legendary: Jamboree, the Strawberry Sovereign

lore.common: Escapes the butter knife and lands neatly on a clean shirt.
lore.uncommon: Holds the jar lid shut until someone promises to share a scone.
lore.rare: Can leap from one slice of toast to the next without spilling a single strawberry seed.
lore.epic: Burst from a giant jam jar at the county fair and painted every white tent scarlet. The bakers called it an unexpected marketing triumph.
lore.legendary: Jamboree once preserved the final summer strawberry through a hundred winters. Anyone who tastes it hears bees humming in a garden that no longer exists.

names.legendary: Summerjar, Keeper of July Afternoons

lore.common: Refuses to unscrew until somebody gives it a very stern look.
lore.uncommon: Makes every biscuit taste faintly of the pickles it held last winter.
lore.rare: Stores the smell and flavour of anything that was ever kept inside. The family now owns a haunted marmalade jar.
lore.epic: Defeated every adult at the dinner table until the smallest child opened it with one finger. The adults declared the lid defective.
lore.legendary: Summerjar bottled the warmth of a perfect July afternoon before the old village was abandoned. Opening its lid in winter fills the room with sunlight and forgotten laughter.

names.legendary: Hazelwick, Keeper of the Endless Jar

lore.common: Leaves chocolate fingerprints on the kitchen cupboard and blames the dog.
lore.uncommon: Hides the spoon beneath its lid so nobody knows who has been sampling.
lore.rare: Disappears behind the jam whenever a parent comes into the kitchen. Returns the moment the toast is ready.
lore.epic: Swiped across every breakfast table in the village and gave the entire school matching chocolate moustaches for photo day.
lore.legendary: Hazelwick found an enchanted hazelnut grove that grew a single never-empty jar beneath its oldest tree. Every spoonful tastes like the happiest breakfast its eater remembers.

names.legendary: Lord Nutclasp, Binder of the Great Bell

lore.common: Clings to the roof of the mouth until its owner learns to speak fluent muffled.
lore.uncommon: Hides a spoon in the jar and claims it came that way from the shop.
lore.rare: Switches between smooth and crunchy every time someone says they have a preference.
lore.epic: Glued an entire picnic to its blanket during a heatwave. The ants had to register as permanent residents.
lore.legendary: Lord Nutclasp held the cracked bell of a hilltop village together with one enchanted spoonful. Its first peal after the storm was so loud the squirrels fell out of their trees.

names.legendary: Lord Dillorian of the Eternal Brine

lore.common: Hides the biggest gherkin at the bottom, beyond the reach of every fork.
lore.uncommon: Sprays a tiny splash of vinegar onto anyone who finally twists off its lid.
lore.rare: Turns dropped objects into pickles. The kitchen keys are now delicious but impossible to use.
lore.epic: Burst open in the royal pantry and pickled every vegetable in the kingdom overnight. The carrots formed a resistance movement.
lore.legendary: Lord Dillorian kept a single cucumber preserved through three fallen empires. When the jar finally opened, its brine restored the abandoned royal gardens to life.

names.legendary: Salsa del Sol, the Thousand-Pepper Queen

lore.common: Leaves a bright red stain on the one shirt that was clean for dinner.
lore.uncommon: Waits for somebody to call it mild, then adds one very mischievous chilli seed.
lore.rare: Turns an ordinary tortilla chip into a red-hot dragon tongue. The bravest guest immediately asks for milk.
lore.epic: Jumped out of the bowl at a fiesta and danced across every plate. By midnight the entire dining hall was breathing tiny clouds of steam.
lore.legendary: Salsa del Sol ground a thousand peppers beneath a summer eclipse. One taste makes even the coldest heart dance, though the royal cook keeps an emergency jug of yoghurt nearby.

names.legendary: Jarra Jinn, Keeper of the Sealed Scent

lore.common: Opens only when nobody is cooking and sneezes oregano onto the floor.
lore.uncommon: Changes its label to 'cinnamon' every time somebody is making chocolate cake.
lore.rare: Holds the smell of any dinner ever cooked and can summon it strongly enough to make entire streets hungry.
lore.epic: Swapped every spice in the royal pantry during a banquet. The dessert became a curry and the curry developed a sweet tooth.
lore.legendary: Jarra Jinn has been sealed since the first feast of the ancient world. Opening it releases every forgotten recipe as a cloud of wonderful smells.

names.legendary: Freshford, Keeper of First Light

lore.common: Gets folded shut with its pouring spout still sticking out of the fridge door.
lore.uncommon: Leaves one mouthful of milk inside and returns to the shelf looking innocent.
lore.rare: Changes the printed expiry date whenever someone looks away, sending the family into a breakfast debate.
lore.epic: Opened from the wrong side and launched a white fountain across the table, landing every drop neatly in the cat's bowl.
lore.legendary: Freshford once held the first milk of a spring morning without losing its sweetness. When opened a century later, it smelled of fresh grass and the day began anew.

names.legendary: Cacaora, Hearth of the Long Winter

lore.common: Steals every marshmallow the moment you look away from your mug.
lore.uncommon: Grows a thick chocolate skin on top and insists it is wearing a winter coat.
lore.rare: Summons marshmallows from nearby cupboards until the mug looks like a floating snowball village.
lore.epic: Brewed a chocolate cloud over the Christmas market. It rained warm cocoa and the snowmen demanded refunds.
lore.legendary: When the mountain village ran out of firewood, Cacaora filled every hearth with chocolate steam. The winter spirits stayed for dessert and forgot to bring the frost.

names.legendary: Camellia, the Cup That Ended a War

lore.common: Refuses to cool down until the owner forgets it on the windowsill.
lore.uncommon: Infuses itself for so long that the spoon stands straight up on its own.
lore.rare: Steams out a tiny umbrella over anyone who needs a moment of quiet.
lore.epic: Brewed such a fierce cup for the street party that the bunting stood rigid and the mayor delivered his speech at double speed.
lore.legendary: Camellia was poured between two enemies on the morning of their final battle. They argued about milk first, then biscuits, and forgot why they had drawn swords.

names.legendary: Haloria, Who First Seasoned the Sea

lore.common: Clumps together whenever somebody is in a hurry to season their chips.
lore.uncommon: Hides in a pastry instead of the sugar and lets the baker discover the mistake.
lore.rare: Preserves a sailor's lunch for a hundred years. He still says it could use a pinch more.
lore.epic: Rolled across a banquet table in a glittering white wave, turning every dish into something so salty that the guests begged for rain.
lore.legendary: Haloria shed one tear into the world's first ocean and gave it its salt. The sea still offers her a pearl every year in thanks, though she says she prefers chips.

names.legendary: Pinch Perfect, Keeper of the Final Grain

lore.common: Sprinkles two grains of salt when you want a heap, then empties itself onto your lap.
lore.uncommon: Loosens its cap at the exact moment Dad tries to impress dinner guests.
lore.rare: Swaps its white crystals for black pepper when nobody is watching. The chef has begun labelling everything twice.
lore.epic: Sneezed during the wedding dinner and buried the five-tier cake beneath a snowy mound of salt. The caterer still has not forgiven the pepper mill.
lore.legendary: Pinch Perfect once seasoned a banquet with a single grain, balancing every flavour so flawlessly that the cooks laid down their spoons and applauded.

names.legendary: Masalith, the Thousand-Taste Chimera

lore.common: Makes the cook sneeze the moment a delicate measurement is required.
lore.uncommon: Mixes its cinnamon and chilli on purpose, turning breakfast into an unexpected adventure.
lore.rare: Changes the flavour of food by whispering the name of a faraway city into the pot.
lore.epic: Stormed through a culinary contest as a fragrant whirlwind, turning competitors into walking recipes. The judge awarded first place to a tree.
lore.legendary: Masalith was born when a thousand markets opened on the same morning. Its breath carries every flavour ever discovered and one no human tongue can describe.

names.legendary: Mistralia, Gardener of the Little Clouds

lore.common: Squirts the person holding it instead of the wilting plant directly in front.
lore.uncommon: Makes the fern believe it has its own personal weather forecast.
lore.rare: Fires a single droplet accurately enough to hit a spider's hat on the other side of the greenhouse.
lore.epic: Summoned a miniature monsoon inside the botanical gardens, washing the dust off every leaf and the tourists off every bench.
lore.legendary: Mistralia coaxed the last desert cactus into flower with one silver mist. The bloom was so beautiful the clouds came to admire it and stayed.

names.legendary: Makizura, the Seaweed Serpent

lore.common: Loses one grain of rice every time it rolls away from the plate.
lore.uncommon: Hides the wasabi under the mildest-looking piece and watches guests discover it.
lore.rare: Unrolls into a winding seaweed serpent that steals chopsticks and neatly returns them crossed.
lore.epic: Took command of the restaurant conveyor belt and coiled around every table, leaving a seaweed trail through the dining room.
lore.legendary: Makizura braided a river of moonlit rice into the first nori roll, feeding a fleet of lost sailors one bite each until they reached shore.

names.legendary: Thermorin, the Last Summer Ember

lore.common: Leaks exactly one drop of soup into the bottom of a school bag.
lore.uncommon: Turns its lid into a little cup but refuses to fit back on after lunch.
lore.rare: Holds tea piping hot in a blizzard while somehow keeping an ice lolly frozen in the other compartment.
lore.epic: Opened its lid atop the frozen mountain and released a cloud of tea-scented warmth that drew every shivering explorer to camp.
lore.legendary: Thermorin carried a single sip of summer through the longest polar night. When the explorers shared it, the aurora burned gold instead of green for one evening.

names.legendary: Vaseraph, Cradle of Lost Springs

lore.common: Leaves a perfect damp ring beneath its favourite flowers.
lore.uncommon: Tilts toward an open window like a performer about to faint.
lore.rare: Revives the droopiest daisy when nobody is there to see it.
lore.epic: Shattered into a thousand glittering pieces, then assembled itself around a bouquet before the cat could take the blame.
lore.legendary: Held the last flower of a vanished garden through seven winters. When spring returned, its water became a river of blossoms through the abandoned town.

names.legendary: Cuvella, the Glassbound Voyager

lore.common: Pops its cork at the least appropriate part of a solemn dinner.
lore.uncommon: Collects damp labels from other bottles and wears them like medals.
lore.rare: Traps a whispered secret beneath its cork; tip it sideways and the secret rattles around the glass.
lore.epic: Duchess Corkquake burst from her cellar with a cork cannonade that rang every bell in the manor. The butler resigned into a cupboard.
lore.legendary: Cuvella sailed a miniature ocean sealed inside a bottle for a hundred years. When the cork finally lifted, the tiny crew asked whether the outside world had invented biscuits yet.

names.legendary: Aerosaur, the Last Exhalation

lore.common: Hides in its can and whispers "pssst" at anyone who walks past. It has absolutely nothing useful to say.
lore.uncommon: Shakes itself before making decisions. Its decisions are mostly lemon-scented.
lore.rare: Can hiss its owner's full name through the nozzle. Saves the trick for uncomfortable dinner parties.
lore.epic: One furious spray became a citrus thundercloud above the entire city. Meteorologists called it a lemon warning.
lore.legendary: The last breath of a forgotten sky god sleeps inside its pressurised can. It escaped once; the moon smelled of lavender for a century.

names.legendary: Pinephora, Keeper of Forgotten Forests

lore.common: Sneezes a puff of pine scent whenever someone enters. The actual pine trees find it offensive.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of fragrance precisely one minute before the guests arrive. It has a talent for tragedy.
lore.rare: Can replace any smell with the aroma of someone's happiest memory. The dog keeps requesting sausages.
lore.epic: One spritz transformed the supermarket into a pine forest. Squirrels immediately declared aisle seven their capital.
lore.legendary: One breath of Pinephora's perfume summons the scent of a vanished forest. On a special day, the trees themselves return.

names.legendary: Amygdrax, Heart of the Golden Grove

lore.common: A tiny nut beast with a shell twice its confidence. Challenges walnuts to arm-wrestling and loses to raisins.
lore.uncommon: Hides inside snack bowls and bites the fingers that steal the last almond. Its lawyer calls this self-defence.
lore.rare: Burrows into coat pockets and sprouts miniature almond orchards. Dry cleaners have started charging for landscaping.
lore.epic: Cracked its shell and unleashed a marching army of marzipan knights. The bakery surrendered before breakfast.
lore.legendary: Legends say Amygdrax guards the first almond tree, whose blossoms grant one wish. It has spent centuries wishing for someone who isn't allergic.

names.legendary: Porcinox, Herald of the Eternal Sizzle

lore.common: Sizzles before the pan is even hot. Claims it is rehearsing for breakfast.
lore.uncommon: Sneaks off plates in the shape of a crispy ghost. Every missing rasher is blamed on the dog.
lore.rare: Can summon the smell of frying bacon from three villages away. Even vegetarians look toward the kitchen in confusion.
lore.epic: Released a sizzling aroma so mighty that every alarm clock in the city rang for breakfast at once. The bakeries ran out of bread by sunrise.
lore.legendary: Porcinox guards the mythical frying pan that never cools. Its first sizzle awakened the appetite of the gods, who have been arguing over the last rasher ever since.

names.legendary: Gingerfoam, Brewer of Thunderclouds

lore.common: Fizzles up a glass of ginger beer until the first sip tickles the drinker's nose.
lore.uncommon: Builds a head of foam taller than the glass. Has never once paid for the wasted napkins.
lore.rare: Grows fresh froth each time someone blows it away. The glass is now mostly air and resentment.
lore.epic: Exploded from the summer fair in a wave of ginger bubbles. Every cake was instantly crowned with spicy icing.
lore.legendary: Brewed a fizzy storm above the cricket ground. The rain tasted of ginger for three days, and the teams requested extra innings.

names.legendary: Lady Whiteout, Scourge of All Colours

lore.common: Hides under the sink behind a childproof cap. It considers this a noble prison.
lore.uncommon: Clicks its lid like a judge's gavel whenever a stain enters the bathroom.
lore.rare: Makes mould pack up and move out before it even opens the bottle. The spiders leave forwarding addresses.
lore.epic: Whitened the royal laundry so thoroughly that every flag in the kingdom turned blank. Diplomats are still arguing over whose flag is whose.
lore.legendary: She once challenged a rainbow to a duel and returned with seven perfectly white ribbons. Even the clouds now hide their coloured socks.

names.legendary: Bubbloria, Duchess of the Cleansing Tide

lore.common: Promises lavender and releases a mystery smell strongly resembling tropical fruit salad.
lore.uncommon: Waits until the bottle is almost empty, then produces enough gel to wash a horse.
lore.rare: Changes its fragrance with every squeeze. Tonight's special is coconut, pine and inexplicable fish fingers.
lore.epic: Filled the entire apartment block with bubbles. Residents climbed down the stairwell on giant soap spheres and called it the best lift ever.
lore.legendary: Her shimmering lather can wash a bad day from memory. Once she cleaned a pirate ship so thoroughly its crew forgot how to be pirates.

names.legendary: Sir Screwtop, Keeper of a Million Seals

lore.common: Rolls under the sofa the instant it leaves a bottle. Nobody has discovered where it lives.
lore.uncommon: Fires itself into the dog's water bowl whenever the kitchen goes quiet.
lore.rare: Screws onto the wrong bottle and turns orange juice into a surprise milkshake experiment.
lore.epic: Locked every fizzy drink in town overnight and demanded a royal ransom of three teaspoons. The cola factories called it a crisis.
lore.legendary: Sir Screwtop once sealed an ocean inside a bottle for a thirsty giant. He still refuses to reveal where he put the opening instructions.

names.legendary: Empress Bobaria, Keeper of Chewy Stars

lore.common: Hides its last tapioca pearl at the bottom of the cup until the straw gives up.
lore.uncommon: Blocks the giant straw at exactly the worst moment. It enjoys the look of panic.
lore.rare: Launches pearls at anyone who forgets to say thank you. The cafe staff have granted it honorary employment.
lore.epic: Filled the cinema with a storm of flying boba after someone took one enormous sip. The audience called it a surprisingly interactive film.
lore.legendary: Bobaria's pearls are said to be tiny moons rescued from the bottom of the sea. One sip can send a dreamer sailing through a thousand sweet constellations.

names.legendary: Aromara, Oracle of the Unbaked Cookie

lore.common: Smells like fresh cookies, but contains exactly zero cookies. Considers this an excellent prank.
lore.uncommon: Burns a tunnel down its centre, leaving a wax fortress around the edge.
lore.rare: Changes its scent from lavender to ancient library to wet dog based on whoever enters the room.
lore.epic: Filled a ballroom with such convincing bakery smells that the guests began eating the table decorations. The catering company sued.
lore.legendary: Aromara can conjure the scent of any memory in existence. One whiff of childhood Christmas made an entire army abandon its siege and go home for pudding.

names.legendary: Casharia, Empress of the Salted Moon

lore.common: Is always the first nut picked from the bowl. It is extremely smug about this.
lore.uncommon: Rolls away from the peanuts at parties, claiming they are not of equal social standing.
lore.rare: Transforms any nearby peanut into a cashew. The snack company calls it a supply-chain miracle.
lore.epic: Escaped the snack bowl with a crescent-shaped army and stole the moon's reflection from every pond in town.
lore.legendary: Casharia was curved from a sliver of moonlight and salted by the sea. Each new moon she collects a kingdom's worth of cashews for her celestial banquet.

names.legendary: Lord Chestnar, the Ember-Hearted

lore.common: Escapes its prickly husk and rolls under the nearest shoe. Calls this a duel.
lore.uncommon: Pops from the fire just when everybody has stopped watching. The dog no longer trusts autumn.
lore.rare: Roasts itself over cold embers and emerges wearing a suit of bronze armour.
lore.epic: Turned every fallen chestnut in the forest into a marching army of polished little helmets. The squirrels declared martial law.
lore.legendary: Chestnar was forged in the first autumn fire and wears a crown of burrs. He grants shelter to every lost traveller, provided they can crack his notoriously terrible jokes.

names.legendary: Colonel Scorch, Sauce Sultan

lore.common: Steals the last napkin before letting anybody pick it up. The sauce has already won.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be mild. The first bite introduces an entirely different business arrangement.
lore.rare: Glows red whenever someone says I can handle spicy. The fire extinguisher begins trembling.
lore.epic: Unleashed a sauce storm across the championship buffet. The opposing team surrendered after its third napkin.
lore.legendary: Colonel Scorch guards the original recipe etched into a bone-shaped golden tablet. Eleven herbs, seven spices and one ingredient that has been declared a national security secret.

names.legendary: Garbanthos, the Thousand-Bean Monarch

lore.common: Rolls away from the spoon one pea at a time. The fork has already given up.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be a tiny chick. It is a bean, and nobody has the heart to tell it.
lore.rare: Multiplies whenever someone opens a tin. The kitchen counter has started looking like a crowded football stadium.
lore.epic: Marched an army of chickpeas from the pantry and conquered every salad bowl in the city. The hummus factories offered peace.
lore.legendary: Garbanthos rules an underground kingdom of legumes where every citizen becomes hummus by choice. The royal throne is made of a single enormous pita.

names.legendary: Lady Spickandra, Scourge of the Filthy

lore.common: Sprays in the wrong direction until you stop looking. Its nozzle is an expert liar.
lore.uncommon: Knows exactly which jumper you washed yesterday and aims for that one.
lore.rare: Erases stains so thoroughly it sometimes removes the memory of the party that caused them.
lore.epic: Purified the royal kitchen until the marble floors became mirrors. The king spent three hours arguing with his own reflection.
lore.legendary: Lady Spickandra once cleaned a haunted castle so thoroughly the ghosts lost their hiding places. They now haunt the laundry basket and leave excellent reviews.

names.legendary: Theobroma, Oracle of the Dark Cup

lore.common: Puffs a brown cloud into your face whenever the tin opens. It calls this aromatherapy.
lore.uncommon: Turns the first spoonful into a stubborn island of dry powder. Cannot be persuaded to sink.
lore.rare: Turns steam from any kettle into the scent of hot cocoa. Twelve people queued outside the dentist thinking it was a café.
lore.epic: Painted the clouds deep cocoa brown above the winter market. Every snowflake tasted faintly of pudding, and the meteorologists were delighted.
lore.legendary: Theobroma knows the oldest story ever told over a warm cup. Listen carefully to its steam and you may hear the first winter, before anybody invented marshmallows.

names.legendary: Caffelgrim, Keeper of the Sacred Roast

lore.common: Puffs coffee smell through a tiny valve whenever somebody squeezes its belly.
lore.uncommon: Spills exactly a teaspoon of grounds when opened. The counter has stopped fighting.
lore.rare: Can lure sleepy neighbours through solid walls with one deep breath of roasted beans.
lore.epic: Released a fragrant brown fog across the office tower and turned every meeting room into an unofficial café. Productivity was briefly mistaken for happiness.
lore.legendary: Caffelgrim guards the beans roasted in the first fire of morning. Their scent can awaken a sleeping king, but the king still asks for five minutes and a biscuit.

names.legendary: Arabicarus, General of Dawn

lore.common: Rolls off the counter and hides beneath the fridge like a tiny brown escape artist.
lore.uncommon: Rattles in the grinder loudly enough to wake the people who haven't even gone to bed yet.
lore.rare: Can make an entire room feel alert just by being roasted. The office plants have started submitting reports.
lore.epic: Marched across the city at sunrise in a thousand-bean army. Every café opened early, and nobody managed an afternoon nap.
lore.legendary: Arabicarus led the first rebellion against sleep and won the battle of Monday Morning. His soldiers are small, roasted and incapable of agreeing on how strong the coffee should be.

names.legendary: Silkenna, Queen of Untied Knots

lore.common: Escapes the bottle in one enormous blob. The rest of the shower becomes a skating rink.
lore.uncommon: Makes hair so silky that hats, clips and common sense slide straight off.
lore.rare: Unravels knots with a whisper, including the ones in the family tree nobody discusses.
lore.epic: Gave an entire rock band such flowing hair that their headbanging generated a coastal wind warning.
lore.legendary: Combed the legendary sea-serpent's endless mane without snapping a strand. The serpent offered her a kingdom; she requested a better shower drain.

names.legendary: Corkelius, the Sea's Smallest Captain

lore.common: Escapes every bottle and immediately hides behind the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Floats through floods with a little paper hat. Calls itself a navy.
lore.rare: Seals a bottle so fiercely that the wine ages backwards and becomes grapes.
lore.epic: Shot out of a party bottle and struck the royal chandelier. The ensuing cascade of crystals became a national holiday.
lore.legendary: Crossed seven oceans carrying a message written by a shipwrecked princess. The reply arrived three centuries late and simply said, Wrong number.

names.legendary: Purificax, Judge of the Filthy Realm

lore.common: Leaves a sticky dribble down the bottle, no matter how carefully you pour.
lore.uncommon: Makes every load of washing smell like an aggressively cheerful meadow.
lore.rare: Turns all the white socks pink and blames the washing machine's artistic period.
lore.epic: Filled the entire apartment block with bubbles. The residents floated downstairs instead of taking the lift.
lore.legendary: Once washed the armour of a fallen kingdom until it shone like dawn itself. Purificax cannot remove guilt, but the uniforms have never looked cleaner.

names.legendary: Saponara, Empress of the Silver Suds

lore.common: Escapes the bottle in one enormous blob whenever somebody only wants a drop.
lore.uncommon: Makes the sponge so slippery it tries to flee the kitchen.
lore.rare: Can scrub a burnt pan clean by glaring at it. The pan has developed performance anxiety.
lore.epic: Flooded the royal kitchens with bubbles tall enough to engulf the chandeliers. The king was discovered floating in a saucepan.
lore.legendary: When the first ocean turned oily, Saponara washed its waves clean with one shimmering breath. Even today, the sea leaves tiny bubbles on her doorstep.

names.legendary: Drumflame, Lord of the Golden Crust

lore.common: Leaves fingerprints on everything except the napkin.
lore.uncommon: Covers itself in so much sauce that the plate needs a raincoat.
lore.rare: Its crunchy skin rings like a tiny drum. Restaurants have banned it from quiet tables.
lore.epic: Led a revolt of fried chicken legs across the banquet, demanding equal rights for the wings. The guests voted for extra sauce.
lore.legendary: Once served at the feast of a thousand giants, Drumflame remained perfectly crisp through seven days of rain. The giants still search the kitchen for its secret spice.

names.legendary: Saint Scentula of the Thousand Naps

lore.common: Claims one tiny drop will solve absolutely everything, including parking problems.
lore.uncommon: Spills three drops at once and then lectures you about moderation.
lore.rare: Turns every room into a lavender field. Even the vacuum cleaner speaks in a soothing voice.
lore.epic: Sold the mayor a potion of perfect calm. By noon the entire council was asleep, the pigeons were chairing meetings and the fountain had resigned.
lore.legendary: Scentula bottled the fragrance of the first spring morning. When it opened during a royal quarrel, both armies sat down to compare bath salts and never resumed fighting.

names.legendary: Admiral Haddock, Lord of the Last Chip

lore.common: Leaks vinegar through its paper wrapping exactly onto the clean trousers.
lore.uncommon: Attracts seagulls from six streets away. Denies advertising.
lore.rare: Can make a newspaper headline smell of hot chips. The editors are furious.
lore.epic: Escaped the chip shop in a paper boat and led a hungry seagull armada along the promenade. The lifeguards were forced to negotiate with tartare sauce.
lore.legendary: Admiral Haddock sailed across the seven seas in a hull of golden batter, using two chips as oars. He returned with treasure, three lemons and no intention of sharing.

names.legendary: Filletus, the Fish That Swam Back

lore.common: Falls apart the moment the spatula looks at it.
lore.uncommon: Hides a single unexpected bone as a practical joke. The cook is not amused.
lore.rare: Swims across the dinner plate whenever someone squeezes lemon nearby.
lore.epic: Leapt from a frying pan and covered the banquet hall in flying golden flakes. The king declared it the most delicious snowfall in history.
lore.legendary: Filletus was divided into a hundred perfect flakes, yet every piece remembered the sea. One moonlit night they reassembled and slipped back into the tide, trailing breadcrumbs.

names.legendary: Farina, Mother of the First Loaf

lore.common: Coats the kitchen in fine white dust and blames the cat.
lore.uncommon: Leaves handprints on everything the baker touches, including the postman.
lore.rare: Can turn a spill into a little snowdrift that rises when nobody is watching.
lore.epic: Burst from a split flour sack during the royal baking contest and turned the entire palace white. The judges handed out prizes to the wrong bakers.
lore.legendary: Farina remembers the first loaf baked by a human hand. Each dawn she visits a different kitchen, whispering one ancient recipe to the baker willing to share the bread.

names.legendary: Crunchzilla, the Golden Drumstick

lore.common: Wears a jacket of crunchy batter and leaves edible confetti everywhere it goes.
lore.uncommon: Loses more crumbs than it has meat. Every ant in the picnic park has put it on the guest list.
lore.rare: A bite of its crust cracks like a signal drum, summoning every hungry dog within a mile. The dog walkers now carry earplugs.
lore.epic: The giant bucket of fried chicken marched through the festival demanding dipping sauce. The town fountain now flows with gravy.
lore.legendary: Once a century Crunchzilla's golden crust rings like a bell, summoning every hungry traveller. The feast ends only when someone remembers napkins.

names.legendary: Jerrik, Keeper of the Last Drop

lore.common: Guards its precious fuel in the shed and becomes suspiciously light whenever the mower is needed.
lore.uncommon: Claims it contains enough fuel to mow the lawn. Makes this claim every spring.
lore.rare: Can fill a mower without spilling a drop, but never without spilling at least one insult at the gardener.
lore.epic: Hid the last fuel in the village just before the lawn competition. The contestants invented a new sport: competitive scything.
lore.legendary: During the longest winter, Jerrik guarded the final can of fuel so carefully that nobody dared use it. In spring he discovered it was full of lemonade.

names.legendary: Propanora, Guardian of the Eternal Grill

lore.common: Stands beside the barbecue looking important. Refuses to confirm how much gas is left until the sausages are half cooked.
lore.uncommon: Always feels empty when lifted and impossibly heavy when it needs carrying.
lore.rare: Keeps a barbecue burning through a thunderstorm and demands compliments for every perfectly cooked sausage. The chef is starting to feel redundant.
lore.epic: Its pressure gauge rose when the guests announced a second barbecue. The lawn chairs braced for impact.
lore.legendary: Propanora supplied the flame to a feast that lasted one hundred nights. When the final guest left, the cylinder was still full and the chef had become a legend.

names.legendary: Transparia, the Windowless Wonder

lore.common: Spritzes the window with blue mist, then insists every smudge is the fault of the cleaning cloth.
lore.uncommon: Cleans the middle of the pane perfectly and leaves the edges decorated with streaks.
lore.rare: Makes reflections so sharp that the cat tries to jump into the other living room.
lore.epic: Polished every shopfront in town so clearly that people walked straight past the shops. Sales fell, but the windows won awards.
lore.legendary: Transparia once cleaned the crystal walls of a lost city until they were invisible. The city remained hidden for centuries because nobody could find the door.

names.legendary: Saponia, Empress of the Clean Hands

lore.common: Squirts exactly one drop farther than the sink can catch. The bathroom floor is very well washed.
lore.uncommon: Smells like roses and behaves like a slippery eel whenever somebody picks up the bottle.
lore.rare: Blows a tiny soap-bubble parade every time someone washes properly. The cat is its most devoted fan.
lore.epic: Produced a mountain of suds so tall that the school caretaker skied down it. Nobody got dirty on the landing.
lore.legendary: Saponia washed the hands of a giant after he built the first bridge. The suds flowed downriver for seven days, carrying every lost rubber duck home.

names.legendary: Nuxford, Keeper of the Hidden Grove

lore.common: Rolls away from the nutcracker and hides under a leaf like a very small criminal.
lore.uncommon: Convinces squirrels to bury it in the same garden every year. The gardener wonders where the forest came from.
lore.rare: Has a shell so hard the nutcracker asks for reinforced teeth and a day off.
lore.epic: Called every squirrel in the valley to a single garden. By morning the lawn resembled a carefully planted minefield of hazelnuts.
lore.legendary: Nuxford guards a secret grove where each nut contains a memory of autumn. Squirrels bring him bright leaves in exchange for remembering where they buried their winter stores.

names.legendary: Capsaicin Rex, Dragon of the Last Drop

lore.common: Insists it is mild. The warning label is written in tiny, nervous letters.
lore.uncommon: Escapes its dropper in one enormous splash just as the cook says 'only a little.'
lore.rare: Heats the ice cream beside it without ever leaving the bottle.
lore.epic: Turned a chilli-eating contest into a fire brigade training exercise. The milk truck arrived with a police escort.
lore.legendary: A single drop of Capsaicin Rex once woke a sleeping volcano beneath a desert. The volcano sneezed pepper flakes for seven days and now demands yoghurt with every meal.

names.legendary: Quilloria, Keeper of the Unwritten Page

lore.common: Leaves blue fingerprints on anyone who insists the lid is on tight.
lore.uncommon: Stains the one clean cuff in a room full of old shirts.
lore.rare: Corrects every misspelt word written with its ink, including the teacher's marking comments.
lore.epic: Spilled across the library desk and filled every blank page with a different story. Nobody left until the librarian had read them all.
lore.legendary: Quilloria holds the final drop of ink from the first storyteller's pen. Each century it writes one tale nobody knew they needed to hear.

names.legendary: Jerrycanicus, Keeper of the Last Mile

lore.common: Rattles around the car boot on every bend and denies making any noise.
lore.uncommon: Hides its pouring spout precisely when someone needs to refill the mower.
lore.rare: Holds just enough spare fuel to rescue a stranded traveller, never enough for a second detour.
lore.epic: Clunked so rhythmically on a road trip that the entire family started singing along. By the border, another car had joined the band.
lore.legendary: Jerrycanicus crossed the empty desert with the last precious fuel of a rescue convoy. Each vehicle reached the oasis, and the can returned mysteriously full.

names.legendary: Sunsqueeze, Heart of the Golden Orchard

lore.common: Leaves the last bits of pulp at the bottom of the glass just to annoy the drinker.
lore.uncommon: Splashes onto white tablecloths with the enthusiasm of a toddler.
lore.rare: Colours the tongue of anyone who drinks it to match the fruit it was squeezed from.
lore.epic: Splashed out of every breakfast glass in town at sunrise, turning the streets into a fragrant orange parade. The baker opened early.
lore.legendary: Sunsqueeze was pressed from the first orange grown after a hundred dry summers. One sip carries the warmth of that morning, and each seed planted from it grows into a new orchard.

names.legendary: Sultan Skewara of the Thousand Spices

lore.common: Slides the tastiest piece of meat to the very end of the skewer where it cannot be reached.
lore.uncommon: Spins on the grill and somehow burns only the chef's favourite side.
lore.rare: Tosses onions from one skewer to another until every guest gets somebody else's order.
lore.epic: Unleashed an avalanche of grilled peppers and onions at the summer festival. The mayor was crowned with a roasted tomato.
lore.legendary: Skewara guarded the fires of the great desert caravan, turning a single skewer into a feast for a thousand travellers. Every spice merchant still leaves a pinch of cumin in thanks.

names.legendary: Lord Ketchwick, the Scarlet Tide

lore.common: Sneaks from the chip to the shirt without ever touching the plate. No one can explain how.
lore.uncommon: Has perfect aim for white sleeves. It considers napkins a personal insult.
lore.rare: Can turn a perfectly respectable plate of peas into a tomato-red crime scene in one squirt.
lore.epic: Escaped a restaurant's sauce dispenser and painted every white tablecloth scarlet. The mayor thought the town had declared a new flag.
lore.legendary: Lord Ketchwick once flowed uphill from the harbour to rescue a lonely chip. The entire fishing fleet followed the red trail and arrived just in time for dinner.

names.legendary: Baron Bottlesplat, the Last Drop

lore.common: Sleeps upside down in the fridge, preparing a red ambush for breakfast.
lore.uncommon: Grows a hardened plug in its nozzle, then fires it at whoever tries to clean it.
lore.rare: Waits for a silent restaurant before making the loudest possible raspberry through its cap.
lore.epic: Sprayed a perfect ketchup moustache onto every guest at the barbecue, including the mayor's portrait on the wall.
lore.legendary: Baron Bottlesplat survived a thousand squeezes without surrendering the final drop. When it finally emerged, it landed on the king's last chip from three streets away.

names.legendary: Beanadict, Lord of the Red Harvest

lore.common: Escapes the tin and rolls under the fridge to avoid becoming dinner.
lore.uncommon: Clangs against the colander like a tiny prisoner demanding release.
lore.rare: Commands a regiment of red beans that march across the counter and seize the cumin.
lore.epic: Stormed the village chilli contest with an army of beans. Every pot declared itself the winner, and the judges needed three days to recover.
lore.legendary: Beanadict once grew a scarlet beanstalk from the bottom of a cooking pot. At its summit sits the legendary kitchen where every chilli is perfect and nobody argues about the spice.

names.legendary: Zestina, the Fountain of Lost Summers

lore.common: Bubbles so loudly in the glass that everyone expects it to have important news.
lore.uncommon: Hides a lemon pip in every final sip, especially for the person who dislikes surprises.
lore.rare: Tastes sweet to the person who poured it and magnificently sour to everyone else.
lore.epic: Poured itself through the village fair in a fizzy golden wave. Every child cheered and every dentist booked a holiday.
lore.legendary: Zestina fills a hidden fountain that flows only on the hottest afternoon of the year. One sip brings back the laughter of a perfect childhood summer, though nobody can agree whose summer it was.

names.legendary: Lentilia, Hearthkeeper of Winter

lore.common: Rolls across the countertop one tiny disc at a time, then vanishes under the cooker.
lore.uncommon: Thickens a soup while pretending it has done absolutely nothing.
lore.rare: Swells in hot water until the saucepan lid rises by itself like a magician's hat.
lore.epic: Rained down from a tipped sack at the village feast and filled every empty bowl with stew. The cooks declared it a miracle; the cleaners disagreed.
lore.legendary: Lentilia kept a mountain village fed through the longest winter in memory, using a pot that never emptied. Every spring the villagers leave one humble lentil by the hearth in thanks.

names.legendary: Lord Ambersap, the Golden River

lore.common: Escapes the bottle just far enough to glue the cap shut again.
lore.uncommon: Claims every pancake on the table as its personal property.
lore.rare: Turns ordinary syrup into a golden stream that climbs uphill toward hungry waffles.
lore.epic: Flooded the breakfast festival with a wave of sticky amber. Everyone reached the finish line wearing somebody else's shoes.
lore.legendary: Lord Ambersap once caught a hundred years of spring sap in a silver cup. A single drop from his river can sweeten the bitterest memory without changing what happened.

names.legendary: Mayonessa, the Empress of Emulsions

lore.common: Squeezes out of the sandwich the moment someone takes a dignified bite.
lore.uncommon: Waits in a little white blob on the side of the plate, judging the ketchup's manners.
lore.rare: Turns fruit salad, potato salad and even a bowl of peas suspiciously creamy in one wave.
lore.epic: Spread across the royal picnic in a tidal wave and united two feuding families by gluing their tablecloths together.
lore.legendary: Mayonessa once bound oil and water in a truce that neither could break. From their impossible marriage she made a shining white river that feeds every feast in the forgotten kitchens.

names.legendary: Rollo Polpetti, the Hungry Moon

lore.common: Sits on a mound of spaghetti, pretending not to hear the fork coming.
lore.uncommon: Rolls across the plate whenever anyone tries to catch it, leaving tiny trails of tomato sauce.
lore.rare: Whips spaghetti strands like reins and drives its dinner plate straight to the bread basket.
lore.epic: Escaped the village pasta festival and rolled downhill collecting every stray pea and dumpling. The parade followed its enormous red trail.
lore.legendary: Rollo Polpetti once rolled across the night sky, gathering lost stars in a coat of tomato sauce. On clear evenings, the moon still wears one tiny red stain.

names.legendary: Doctor Amberglass, Keeper of Remedies

lore.common: Wears its little measuring cup as a hat and lives well out of children's reach.
lore.uncommon: Keeps its child-resistant lid firmly shut, even when a grown-up is in a hurry.
lore.rare: Measures every prescribed spoonful with the solemn precision of a miniature pharmacist.
lore.epic: Kept the village clinic's medicine bottles sealed and safely labelled through the flood, without losing a single instruction.
lore.legendary: Doctor Amberglass guarded the healing remedies of a forgotten mountain hospital for generations. Each bottle was counted, named and placed safely in the healer's hands when needed.

names.legendary: Lady Shiverella, Queen of Winter Sips

lore.common: Is too thick for its straw, turning every sip into an embarrassing trumpet solo.
lore.uncommon: Saves the loudest possible slurp for the moment the cafe falls quiet.
lore.rare: Freezes its drinking straw solid and offers it as a bonus dessert.
lore.epic: Chilled the entire diner into a miniature snowstorm when someone ordered an extra-large vanilla. The waiters served chips on sledges.
lore.legendary: Lady Shiverella made a milkshake from the first winter snowfall and a forgotten summer's strawberries. One spoonful lets the drinker hear both seasons laughing together.

names.legendary: Cherrylight, the Glass That Touched Dawn

lore.common: Balances a cherry on a wobbling mountain of cream and refuses to acknowledge gravity.
lore.uncommon: Sends its striped straw leaning over the rim like a tiny fishing pole.
lore.rare: Builds a staircase of whipped cream high enough for the cherry to escape to another dessert.
lore.epic: Rose above the restaurant tables like a glass tower, forcing the waiters to deliver extra sprinkles by ladder.
lore.legendary: Cherrylight once lifted the last cherry of summer to the top of the morning sky. When the sun rose, it glowed red for a single moment before falling gently back into the cream.

names.legendary: Musselina, Oracle of the Tidal Feast

lore.common: Stays stubbornly shut while every other shell in the pot opens. Enjoys being the centre of attention.
lore.uncommon: Clamps onto the dinner spoon and insists it has caught a boat.
lore.rare: Opens just wide enough to deliver mysterious advice in a salty whisper, then shuts before anyone can ask what it meant.
lore.epic: Led a thousand mussels in a pot-lid uprising during the seaside festival. The steam lifted the lid and the chef had to negotiate with his own supper.
lore.legendary: Musselina listened to centuries of tides from a bed of blue-black shells. When the great harbour bell fell silent, her hidden chorus guided the fishing fleet home through the fog.

names.legendary: Dijonna, Empress of the Fiery Seed

lore.common: Squeezes a zigzag onto every sausage and signs it with a little yellow flourish.
lore.uncommon: Hides beneath a hot dog bun, then leaps out to surprise the first unsuspecting bite.
lore.rare: Makes even the bravest eater's nose tingle. The pepper shaker now treats it with respect.
lore.epic: Spread a golden stripe across the entire banquet table and set every royal nose sneezing in time. The king declared it the official national anthem.
lore.legendary: Dijonna was ground from a seed stolen from the sun's own garden. One taste made the winter king weep warm tears, thawing the river and freeing his frozen ships.

names.legendary: Noodlezen, the Feast at the Summit

lore.common: Rattles its dried noodle brick whenever somebody looks hungry.
lore.uncommon: Hides the flavour sachet in the one fold of the wrapper nobody checks.
lore.rare: Splits into exactly a thousand crunchy pieces when the chef needs it whole.
lore.epic: Escaped a student cupboard and cooked itself in every mug on campus. The examination hall smelled of chicken broth for three days.
lore.legendary: Noodlezen was carried to the top of the highest mountain in a traveller's pocket. There it conjured a steaming banquet from a single packet and three drops of melting snow.

names.legendary: Nuggetsaurus Rex, King of the Dip

lore.common: Rolls through breadcrumbs until it looks like a tiny fried cloud.
lore.uncommon: Dives into the ketchup and resurfaces wearing a red battle helmet.
lore.rare: Changes from dinosaur to star to suspiciously familiar face every time it is turned over.
lore.epic: Led an army of golden nuggets out of the school canteen, marching through the playground with dipping sauces for shields. The lunch staff demanded a rematch.
lore.legendary: Nuggetsaurus Rex rose from the first enchanted fryer and roared so loudly that every ketchup bottle bowed. Its kingdom remains the last clean corner of the dinner plate.

names.legendary: Oleandra, Keeper of the Last Tick

lore.common: Leaves one oily ring on the shelf to mark its territory.
lore.uncommon: Slips from its own greasy neck and pretends it had nothing to do with the mess.
lore.rare: Makes a frying pan so slippery that pancakes perform perfect backflips without assistance.
lore.epic: Turned a kitchen floor into an accidental skating rink during Sunday dinner. The cook delivered every plate with an elegant spin and a terrified smile.
lore.legendary: Oleandra poured one golden drop into the ancient town clock, and its rusty hands began moving again. For one glorious hour it gave every tired villager the extra morning they needed.

names.legendary: Aurelia, Anointer of Ancient Kings

lore.common: Escapes the bottle in a thin golden thread that somehow lands on the tablecloth.
lore.uncommon: Gives every salad leaf a glamorous shine and every jar a permanent greasy handshake.
lore.rare: Turns the stiffest bread crust supple enough to tie a bow. The bakers are furious.
lore.epic: Slipped through the banquet kitchen and made every rolling pin, frying pan and loaf skate across the floor. Dinner was served at the finish line.
lore.legendary: Pressed from the grove of a forgotten queen, Aurelia was said to heal the oldest cracked statues. The marble heroes still gleam after a thousand rainstorms.

names.legendary: Perloria, Mother of the Moon Pearl

lore.common: Closes its rough shell whenever someone asks what is inside.
lore.uncommon: Hides a grain of sand like a priceless family heirloom and refuses to show visitors.
lore.rare: Tells sailors where the next tide will carry them, but only after they compliment its shell.
lore.epic: Opened during a palace feast to reveal a pearl that shone so brightly the chandeliers switched themselves off. The guests demanded curtains at noon.
lore.legendary: Perloria sheltered a lost moonbeam beneath her shell for a hundred tides, polishing it into a pearl. When the sea grew dark, she opened it and lit the way for every ship in the bay.

names.legendary: Aerosia of the Thousand Murals

lore.common: Rattles like a tin full of marbles and paints exactly one finger every time.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a bright halo on the wall around the thing that was meant to be painted.
lore.rare: Sprays such fine mist that old patterns reappear through the fresh colour like hidden messages.
lore.epic: Covered an empty skate park in a moving mural of dragons and rockets. The painted creatures refused to stay on their assigned ramps.
lore.legendary: Aerosia restored the stories of a lost town by spraying them across its crumbling walls. Each picture moved at sunset, teaching the children the names their ancestors had forgotten.

names.legendary: Pastavox, Keeper of the Endless Supper

lore.common: Drops three dry pieces on the counter every time anyone wants just one handful.
lore.uncommon: Opens at the bottom and pretends the resulting mess was an innovative serving method.
lore.rare: Swaps fusilli for spaghetti in the box overnight. The sauce has to renegotiate its plans.
lore.epic: Burst in the pantry and unleashed a winding staircase of pasta that carried the family straight to the ceiling. The cat refused to come down for dinner.
lore.legendary: Pastavox carried the last grain of wheat through a long drought. From one enchanted box came enough pasta to feed a whole city, though every meal involved a different shape.

names.legendary: Peanutarch of the Hidden Orchard

lore.common: Rattles two little kernels inside its shell like siblings arguing over the top bunk.
lore.uncommon: Leaves broken shells on every chair after the picnic and calls it confetti.
lore.rare: Grows one extra kernel for anyone who shares their snacks. Hoarders get an empty shell.
lore.epic: Hosted a feast beneath the football pitch for a thousand hungry field mice. The players arrived to find the centre circle covered in tiny peanut shells.
lore.legendary: Peanutarch guarded a secret underground orchard where every pod grew in perfect pairs. When winter came, his little kingdom shared its stores with every creature above the soil.

names.legendary: Pecanor, Guardian of the Autumn Grove

lore.common: Has a wrinkly little shell that looks like the face of a very tired walnut.
lore.uncommon: Hides under the pie crust and pops up exactly when someone asks for extra cream.
lore.rare: Can form perfect golden rings on a pie without a single nut falling out of line.
lore.epic: Armoured a whole bakery in caramelised pecans during the harvest fair. The pastry chef needed a tiny chisel to open the door.
lore.legendary: Pecanor stood watch over the oldest nut grove through seven harsh winters. When the squirrels' stores ran empty, his branches offered just enough for everyone to survive.

names.legendary: Pistachior, Keeper of the Emerald Shell

lore.common: Keeps its shell firmly shut when someone brings out the nutcracker.
lore.uncommon: Opens one side just enough to appear delighted by somebody else's joke.
lore.rare: Snaps shut on a greedy hand but opens politely for anyone who shares their snacks.
lore.epic: Led every pistachio in the market in a rebellion against the nutcrackers. The merchants were forced to negotiate a snack treaty.
lore.legendary: Pistachior's shell contains the world's smallest throne room. Every pistachio in the kingdom must roll past the tiny king and bow before joining a snack bowl.

names.legendary: Propania, Ember of the Endless Camp

lore.common: Hisses beside the campsite stove like a kettle with secrets.
lore.uncommon: Insists on frosting its own sides while cooking everybody else's hot supper.
lore.rare: Keeps a mountain campsite warm through an impossible snowstorm without losing its flame.
lore.epic: Powered a travelling feast through five kingdoms. The barbecue smoke formed a dragon that demanded a vegetarian sausage.
lore.legendary: Propania's blue flame kept a banquet sizzling through seven blizzards. When the guests finally went home, the snowmen insisted on taking leftovers.

names.legendary: Semina, Mother of the Midnight Patch

lore.common: Hides between the pumpkin strings until somebody finds it in their hair.
lore.uncommon: Pops in the roasting tray like a tiny ghost telling a joke.
lore.rare: Sprouts overnight wherever its shell lands, covering the garden in miniature grinning gourds.
lore.epic: Escaped a carving party and planted an entire pumpkin patch inside the town hall. The councillors now sit on orange stools.
lore.legendary: Semina slept inside the first harvest pumpkin. Each seed she scatters grows a lantern that guides lost children safely home before dawn.

names.legendary: Oryzael, Sower of the First Harvest

lore.common: Escapes from its packet and turns up under the kitchen cupboards for months.
lore.uncommon: Hides one crunchy grain in every bowl and calls it character.
lore.rare: Multiplies in the cooking pot until the family needs a second saucepan for the overflow.
lore.epic: Grew into a blizzard of rice across the royal kitchens. The chefs built a mountain of fried rice and planted a flag on top.
lore.legendary: Oryzael sowed one enchanted rice seed that filled the palace granaries overnight. The royal treasurer tried to count the grains and retired three centuries later.

names.legendary: Baron Saucington, Lord of the Last Drop

lore.common: Waits until the chips are gone before surrendering the first drop of sauce.
lore.uncommon: Grows a crust around its cap that cracks like a tiny biscuit whenever it opens.
lore.rare: Fires a perfect squirt across the table at the one person who declared they wanted no sauce.
lore.epic: Squirted a bright red moustache onto every portrait at the annual chip-shop awards. The judges looked surprisingly distinguished.
lore.legendary: Baron Saucington kept the last drop of an ancient family recipe sealed inside his bottle for a century. When he finally released it, every chef in the kingdom asked for another taste.

names.legendary: Sesamora of the Hidden Doors

lore.common: Rolls off a burger bun at the first bite and takes up residence in a shirt collar.
lore.uncommon: Appears on pastries that were definitely plain when they went into the oven.
lore.rare: Whispers the secret password to every cupboard hinge, letting the hungry open even the stubborn jars.
lore.epic: Shouted OPEN SESAME at the bakery and every door, bun and sealed lunchbox in the district sprang open. The pigeons celebrated.
lore.legendary: Sesamora guards a thousand golden gates disguised as ordinary bread crusts. The gates open only for the person willing to share their last sesame bun.

names.legendary: Sudsandra of the Thousand Curls

lore.common: Squeezes the last shampoo into the palm only after you have finished rinsing.
lore.uncommon: Swaps the mint label with the coconut one, then watches the shower argument unfold.
lore.rare: Gives every family member a completely different hairstyle by breakfast. The dog gets a mohawk.
lore.epic: Burst in the hotel spa and covered three floors in scented foam. Guests had to surf down the corridor on towels.
lore.legendary: Sudsandra once washed the storm tangles from a thunder god's hair. Every curl she combed free became a new cloud, and her own bottle has never run empty.

names.legendary: Crustarella, Conductor of the Pink Tide

lore.common: Lets the last prawn slide off the plate precisely when someone offers to share.
lore.uncommon: Arranges its shrimp tails into a fancy fan, then ruins the symmetry by sneezing.
lore.rare: Commands every prawn on the platter to curl into a perfect spiral, uncovering a secret message in the sauce.
lore.epic: Marched a hundred cooked prawns around the banquet table in synchronised formation. The lemon wedges demanded to join the choreography.
lore.legendary: Crustarella conducts the pink tide beneath the deepest banquet hall. At her command, every shrimp rises from the sea in a glistening ballet before politely returning to dinner.

names.legendary: Fructavia, the Rainbow in a Glass

lore.common: Separates into three colourful layers while its owner is answering the door.
lore.uncommon: Leaves one stubborn raspberry seed stuck in the straw as a practical joke.
lore.rare: Changes the colour of anyone who drinks it for an hour. Grandad was a very distinguished shade of purple.
lore.epic: Blended a whole farmers' market into one towering fruit tornado. The market reopened as a tropical juice bar with suspiciously cheerful carrots.
lore.legendary: Fructavia carries the taste of every orchard that has ever flowered. Drink her golden smoothie and one forgotten childhood summer returns for the length of a single sip.

names.legendary: Shoyura, Keeper of the Fifth Taste

lore.common: Slips off the sushi at the last second and paints a brown moustache on the plate.
lore.uncommon: Sneaks a drop into every plain bowl of rice and waits for applause.
lore.rare: Can make any dish taste unforgettable, but the taste follows you around for three days demanding compliments.
lore.epic: Flooded the emperor's banquet with a dark tide of umami so delicious that the palace chefs declared independence from salt.
lore.legendary: Shoyura fermented beneath an ancient temple for a thousand years. One drop makes even the moon's tasteless dust taste like a family feast.

names.legendary: Sojara, the Seed of Endless Forms

lore.common: Pops out of its fuzzy pod and rolls under the fridge before dinner.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be a pea until somebody serves it with a little sea salt.
lore.rare: Transforms from bean to tofu to milk to sauce in seconds, leaving the chef unsure what to order.
lore.epic: Multiplied across the factory into a stampede of tofu blocks and soy-milk waves. The forklifts surrendered to the bean.
lore.legendary: Sojara has worn more bodies than any creature in the pantry. She remembers being the first tofu, the first sauce and the first seed planted beneath the rising sun.

names.legendary: Canister Crow, Silencer of Haunted Doors

lore.common: Rattles ominously whenever the shed door squeaks, then refuses to spray until shaken.
lore.uncommon: Sprays the gardener's boots instead of the rusty wheelbarrow wheel.
lore.rare: Silences every squeaky hinge in a castle, but now the ghosts need bells to announce themselves.
lore.epic: Released a cloud that polished every rusty gate in the town overnight. The gardeners woke to discover the statues had also grown shiny moustaches.
lore.legendary: Canister Crow quieted the door to the underworld with one silver hiss. The restless spirits, unable to make a dramatic entrance, took up polite knocking.

names.legendary: Sirloinor, the Last Flame of the Grill

lore.common: Hisses on the pan whenever somebody presses it to see if it's done.
lore.uncommon: Wears grill marks like military stripes and refuses to be served without an audience.
lore.rare: Commands the sizzling of nearby food like a secret language, summoning hungry dogs from three streets away.
lore.epic: Grew on the barbecue until it towered above the garden like a smoking mountain. The entire neighbourhood arrived carrying forks.
lore.legendary: Sirloinor was seared in the last ember of a legendary forge. A single bite grants the eater the memory of every feast their ancestors ever shared.

names.legendary: Dulcimor, the Sweetest Curse

lore.common: Hides in the cracks of the kitchen floor and attracts bare feet.
lore.uncommon: Coats every spoon in a glittering crust, then squeaks when washed.
lore.rare: Convinces the entire wasp population that a picnic is a royal banquet in its honour.
lore.epic: Turned the school canteen into a syrupy crystal palace; even the carrots wore icing crowns.
lore.legendary: Dulcimor traded a single grain for a baker's final wish. Every bitter fruit in the orchard ripened sweet, but the baker's next cup of tea tasted of onions.

names.legendary: Solgraina, Mother of a Thousand Suns

lore.common: Leaves tiny striped shells in the pockets of innocent park visitors.
lore.uncommon: Starts arguments between squirrels about who gets the last seed.
lore.rare: Sprouts overnight in forgotten lunchboxes and waves its leaves toward the nearest window.
lore.epic: Burst from a bird feeder into a spiralling forest of sunflowers; the birds now need maps to reach the seeds.
lore.legendary: Solgraina planted the first golden field with a single stolen seed. Every autumn a thousand birds carry her next sunrise beneath their wings.

names.legendary: Melloria, the Honey of Lost Summers

lore.common: Leaves one golden drop precisely where an elbow is about to land.
lore.uncommon: Glues the syrup lid shut and pretends it is only protecting the pancakes.
lore.rare: Shoots thin streams of syrup that tie runaway biscuits together in a sticky chain gang.
lore.epic: Wrapped a seven-storey pancake tower in golden ribbons; the entire breakfast buffet had to be rescued with ladders.
lore.legendary: Melloria keeps the final sweetness of a summer that never ended inside an amber bottle. One drop turns a cold winter breakfast into a remembered picnic.

names.legendary: Acetoria, Bane of the Banquet

lore.common: Makes your nose wrinkle before anyone even opens the bottle.
lore.uncommon: Attacks hot chips with a tang sharp enough to wake sleepy seagulls.
lore.rare: Pickles a cucumber in three seconds and immediately asks what else is available.
lore.epic: Turned every chip at the seaside into a sour-faced little sailor. The gulls took one bite and formed a protest committee.
lore.legendary: Once dissolved the golden chains sealing a harbour gate using a single sour drop. The liberated ships still fly a pickle on their flags.

names.legendary: Sir Sourglass of the Seventh Drop

lore.common: Always drips from the nozzle onto the one clean sleeve in the shop.
lore.uncommon: Aims its tiny shaker holes at the table next door.
lore.rare: Replenishes itself overnight, much to the chip-shop owner's confusion.
lore.epic: Sprayed a perfect spiral of vinegar across the beach. Every sandcastle became a pickled fortress, complete with furious crabs.
lore.legendary: Contains seven drops from a legendary storm over the Salt Sea. The final drop can wake a sleeping lighthouse, but it insists on a decent portion of chips first.

names.legendary: Vita Vesper, the Dawn Rattler

lore.common: Makes an enormous fuss whenever the morning routine forgets it.
lore.uncommon: Hides behind the cereal, then rattles in disappointment.
lore.rare: Shakes out a little tune until the household remembers its place beside breakfast.
lore.epic: Rattled so loudly before the school run that every alarm clock in the neighbourhood resigned out of embarrassment.
lore.legendary: Carries the memory of every sunrise it has ever greeted. Even on the longest polar night, its gentle rattling reminds the explorers what morning sounds like.

names.legendary: Walnorius, the Brain in the Shell

lore.common: Looks like a tiny brain and is smug about the resemblance.
lore.uncommon: Rolls beneath the radiator and waits for Christmas to be discovered.
lore.rare: Solves three riddles while the nutcracker struggles with its shell.
lore.epic: Cracked so loudly during the royal feast that the knights rushed in expecting a siege. The squirrel simply asked for seconds.
lore.legendary: Answered every question at a university while trapped inside its shell. When the professors finally cracked it open, there was only a note reading Try thinking harder.

names.legendary: Belladonna, Voice of the Hollow Glass

lore.common: Whistles when someone blows across its long neck, usually during speeches.
lore.uncommon: Leans across the table to eavesdrop on the salt shaker.
lore.rare: Catches the sound of clinking glasses and plays the entire dinner conversation back as music.
lore.epic: Maestro Bottolume assembled a choir from every empty bottle at the wedding. Their final note cracked the cake's icing into sheet music.
lore.legendary: Belladonna was blown from sand found beneath a vanished opera house. Her hollow glass sings the last performance perfectly, including one unmistakably off-key duke.
